fact: Organic Law 53.25, promulgated 16 January 2026, adds article 51 bis punishing false or fabricated election content with 2 to 5 years' prison, and HACA Decision No. 50-26 of 16 June 2026 prohibits broadcasting falsified or AI-generated electoral content likely to mislead the public.
title: AI in Morocco's 2026 Elections: Legal Framework, Observation and a National Task Force
